messages:
Alex (Hiring Manager): Candidate accepted verbally. Need start 2025-02-10 (earlier than posted), requests 27 days PTO (local) and a 7,200 EUR sign-on to cover notice. Relocation 1,200 EUR. Can we route?
Sam (Recruiter): tagging @Lina and @Jo. Role L5 IC, base 155k EUR equiv. Draft offer pending approvals.
Jo (Finance): Note: sign-on >5k so director signoff required. Cost center CHG-77421. Payroll: will treat sign-on as taxable by default. Checking gross-up possibility.
Lina (People Ops): Routing: cross-geo PTO difference + sign-on >5k triggers director approval. Please provide brief business justification.
Alex (Hiring Manager): Business justification: product launch critical in March, candidate brings unique infra expertise. Manager cannot increase base.
Marta (People Ops Director): I approve 7,200 EUR one-time sign-on and 27 days PTO given criticality, contingent on Finance confirming CHG-77421 and payroll processing, and legal if cross-border. Approve start 2025-02-10.
Jo (Finance): CHG-77421 approved. Payroll: sign-on taxable, no gross-up unless manager covers cost.
Sam (Recruiter): Adding conditional language to offer: "Contingent on final payroll tax confirmation." Sending draft.
Lina (People Ops): Exception logged as EX-2025-025. After signature Ops will issue final memo to payroll.
Alex (Hiring Manager): Thanks all, sending verbal now.
